# Lyndsay Feltham

Lyndsay Feltham is the current Deputy of [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). She was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Lyndsay Feltham has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2019 St Helier No 3 & 4 Deputy By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham#e45)

  Not elected.

  - [2019 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2019/lyndsay-feltham-2/)
  - [2019 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e836Sr7ZqiU)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 5 with 54.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/lyndsay-feltham/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZTxPZ6pu_mc)

Lyndsay Feltham has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/10/still-much-more-to-do-says-social-security-minister-ahead-of-re-election-bid/)\]
